HELD LOCALLY since 2026-11-11 (gem-data.zip). Methane estimates for pipelines, LNG terminals, coal mines and oil and gas extraction areas, and satellite methane plumes. NOT LOADED: the asset estimates are emission factors times throughput (GEM, Climate TRACE and OCI+ models), not measurements of a technology, and the coal-mine methane comes in reported form from the Global Coal Mine Tracker (gem_2026_006); plumes are single detections in kg/h, not annual site emissions. Kept for calibrating CIMS methane later: _canada-stock.csv lists the Canadian plume detections with the infrastructure type.
